LanguageData.RM_KethrelMoltDesc: Have the most skilled animal handler coax this kethrel to shed its shell. Everything it carries drops where it stands. A clumsy handler can set off a panicked charge.
LanguageData.RM_KethrelMoltNoHandler: No able animal handler on the map to coax a molt.
LanguageData.RM_KethrelMoltPanic: {0} panicked when {1} tried to coax a molt, and charged.
LanguageData.RM_KethrelLeft: {0} left the area; its shell dropped where it stood.
